review_summary.method: Independent reading of every saved old/new passage and provisional event, with raw-source checks for paragraph boundaries, heading ownership, and nested lists. No pipeline predictions inspected.

review_notes.initial_rationale: Both introductions describe intended Requests API compatibility with exceptions; the following unchanged sentence explicitly frames the API differences.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: Both versions frame Requests compatibility as a design aim with exceptions. The unchanged following sentence already introduces API differences, so the new qualification is wording rather than a new behavioral guarantee.

review_notes.initial_rationale: The URL-object result and explicit string conversion instruction are unchanged in meaning, but one paragraph is naturally split into two.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: The old source has two adjacent sentences in one paragraph; the revised source puts exactly those sentences in separate paragraphs under Request URLs. Keep one 1:2 rewording event rather than an addition.

review_notes.initial_rationale: The exposed text attribute changes from request.text to response.text. Although likely correcting a documentation error, the named API object and asserted behavior differ.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: A likely documentation typo still changes the explicitly named API object from request.text to response.text. Judge the asserted source meaning, without silently correcting the old text.

review_notes.initial_rationale: The SSL setup rule remains, but the explicit trust_env, verify and cert argument list is replaced with generic SSL configurations, removing specific parameter information.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: Replacing the enumerated trust_env, verify, and cert arguments with generic SSL configurations removes parameter-specific guidance. The shared client-instantiation rule does not make the full passages equivalent.

review_notes.initial_rationale: The heading expands the stated response-checking scope from 4xx/5xx to success and failure responses.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: The heading now covers success as well as failures; the following API recommendation also changes. This is a material scope edit, not merely a renamed section.

review_notes.initial_rationale: Replaces checking the complement of is_error with is_success and explicitly limits success to 2xx, changing the recommended API and criterion.
review_notes.reviewer_rationale: The recommendation changes from not is_error to is_success, with an explicit 2xx criterion. Those criteria cannot be treated as interchangeable.
